why: Both analyses land on the key's hedgehog, stop-doing list and brutal facts, but Analysis 2 names profit per active relationship more exactly, adds the deposit cost advantage, shows the eight-products goal is unrealistic, and suspends quotas outright where Analysis 1 only freezes increases. Analysis 1 has the better decline register (terminations treated one at a time, regulatory growth restrictions), but Analysis 2 is slightly more actionable for the leader overall.
